architecture.text: Researchers are optimizing long-context architectures, agentic workflows, and 3D generation through techniques like HySparse2, Gated Token Recurrence, hyperbolic residual quantization, and block-level MoE conditioning.

new-models.text: Frontier releases like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro 1T-A42B and specialized architectures such as MintAct, OmniVChat, and MMAP are driving cost-efficient open-weights training, native audio-visual dialogue, and multimodal medical prediction.

inference-methods.text: Practitioners are deploying on-policy distillation, Disaggregated Quantization, and CompKV to optimize sub-3-bit reasoning, prefill-decode memory bandwidth, and 200K-token long-context inference on consumer hardware.

inference-engines.text: Practitioners are actively deploying Flux, SARA, NVIDIA Topograph, and Hot-Cold HBM-Flash tiering to optimize cluster scheduling, memory tiering, and latency for agentic LLM workloads.

silicon.text: Engineers are optimizing TPU v6e and low-cost FPGAs, improving HBM profiling with RISC-V, and mitigating GPU cluster power surges to scale AI hardware performance.

training.text: Practitioners are deploying group relative policy optimization, instance-aware rubric rewards, and agentic reinforcement learning to systematically mitigate reward hacking and align critics in LLMs.

economics.text: Inference costs and model prices are collapsing industry-wide by 40 to 50 percent, driving a structural shift toward self-hosted open-weight unit economics and near-zero token costs.
